{{nihongo|'''Mika Shrine (Misato town, Saitama)'''|みか神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Musashi Province]].

[[File:Mika-jinja(Misato,Saitama) Hengaku.jpg|265px|thumb|{{center|Dedication plaque of the worship hall}}]]
'''Mika Shrine''' is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located along the {{ill|Tone River|Q177452|qid=Q177452}} in {{ill|Misato, Saitama (town)|Q924129|qid=Q924129|lt=Misato Town}}, {{ill|Kodama District, Saitama|Q938038|qid=Q938038}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|Q128186|qid=Q128186}}. It was the tutelary shrine of the former {{ill|Naka district|Q11642797|qid=Q11642797|lt=Naka District}}. The enshrined deities are Kushimikeno-no-Mikoto and Kushimikatama-no-Mikoto. It is listed as the “Mika Shrine” of Naka District in {{ill|Musashi Province|Q907398|qid=Q907398}} as a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shikinaisha (minor shrine)}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was prefectural shrine.

=== History ===
As there are no records or legends, the date of founding is unknown. Many {{ill|Kofun|Q1141225|qid=Q1141225}} burial mounds remain in the surrounding area, which is enclosed by the Tone River and its tributaries, and rice cultivation has flourished here since ancient times. The “mika” in Mika Shrine is said to originate from large jars used in {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sake making}}.<ref name="社頭掲示板">Shrine notice board (prepared by: Saitama Prefecture, date: March 1983)</ref> The shrine name “mika” is written in kanji as “瓺” plus “[[File:U2ff1-ufa5e-u2ffa-u590c-u7389.svg|18px]]” (diamond + jewel).

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
The following shrines are surrounded by a roofed enclosure around the main buildings:
* Santai Shrine, Suwa Shrine
* Tenjin Tenmangū, Shinmei Shrine, Kokage Shrine
* Sannō Shrine, Matsuo Shrine

The following are groups of stone shrines:
* Komagatake Shrine, Kashima Shrine, Inari Shrine, Atago Shrine, Ameno-Tenaga Shrine, Ōikazuchi Shrine, Amaterasu-Ōmikami, Sukunahikona-no-Kami, Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto, Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto, Haniyasuhime-no-Mikoto, Benten Shrine
